description: Allocate recycled-metal availability within each European destination region.
Only existing intermediate purchases of BASIC_METALS receive the constructed recycled-metal allocation.
Allocate each destination region's recycled-metal availability in proportion to its observed BASIC_METALS intermediate-use values.
Reclassify positive non-inventory REC_EE uses in European destinations as recycled-metal inputs.
Keep the constructed recycled-metal allocation fixed and restore IO identities through the smallest weighted adjustment of the remaining observed flows.
